confidence_notes: Holistic model estimates from general knowledge of Puebla and Mexican pricing, with no live booking pages or listings checked. Restaurant and drink anchors are more reliable than accommodation, which varies widely by neighborhood and booking channel. Estimates assume July, which is rainy season and not peak tourist season. Hotel and hostel prices are the least certain anchors, and the taxes included in the total could shift them.
comparable_city_reasoning: Benchmarked against mid-sized Mexican cities with a historic centre and tourism, such as Oaxaca, Guanajuato and Querétaro, and set below Mexico City and Guadalajara price levels. Drink anchors use the typical local beer-to-cocktail and beer-to-wine price relationship where direct knowledge was weaker.
